source_title: Heterologous expression and biochemical characterization of an endo-beta-1,4-glucanase from Thermobifida fusca
authors: Yan P, Su L, Chen J, Wu J
notes: Verbatim (abstract): 'Using carboxymethyl cellulose as the substrate, the Km and Vmax values were 5.1 mg/mL and 48.7 IU/mg, respectively.' source_title: Temperature Effects on Kinetic Parameters and Substrate Affinity of Cel7A Cellobiohydrolases
